data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 3051 (hashtag rebar-session-lane-04f1), rebased onto origin/main 441ca94f4a8 (one release-notes conflict resolved by keeping both entries, newest first). Plan re-review PASS + certified after the file-impact widening. make verify: lint + typecheck green, pytest 20021 passed, 17 failed = the known arm64 pandoc host defect. A first run also failed `test_arg_sweep_kwargs_heldout.py::test_arg_backlog_is_substantially_reduced` (the whole-tree `ruff --select ARG` backlog cap of 25): the new hook functions carried 21 unused `ctx`/`call` parameters; fixed by `_`-prefixing them, then the full run was clean apart from pandoc. After rebase: lint, typecheck, ADR checks, and the golden/coverage/parity/cross-session/mechanism suites green (251 passed).
